scripts.server: cd server && npx tsx watch index.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:client && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:api: cd server && gcloud run deploy propertyedge-api --source . --region europe-west2 --allow-unauthenticated --platform managed
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:hosting
